description: Allowlist of model backends the AI authoring benchmark (scripts/ai/bench/run_bench.py) may call WITHOUT --allow-paid. Owner decision 2026-10-19: no paid API spend. A backend is matched by scheme + host + port exactly and by URL path prefix. pricePer1kTokens is the per-run cost-estimate rate (USD per 1000 tokens); 0 for local and free tiers. To add a free-tier hosted endpoint, append an entry here; never put a key here (the key comes from NPDEV_BENCH_API_KEY).
